Composition and camera framing already match the four hero shots.

takes.subject: config: move palette halfway to the measured olive/khaki reference values, sun elevation 38°; ledger take-0001 baseline backfill; claims
takes.note: First integrated take after the parallel content passes landed: slab stairs, flagstones with moss joints, white-bark and giant trees with a canopy roof, 500k grass, pod lanterns on the bough, thatch-dome houses, mist and screen-space shafts. Versus the reference: (1) the lantern bough still crosses the top of frames A/B as a thick plain beam where the reference limb is thinner and higher, entering from the left; (2) the grade is cooler and lower-contrast than the olive/khaki reference with its deep cool shadows — palette shifted halfway this take, fog density still lighter than the ~60% haze at 30 m; (3) far hills are untextured grey; (4) stairs and flagstones read too uniformly light with little moss/wear gradient.

takes.subject: ci: do not post the gauntlet PR comment from cancelled runs
takes.note: Take after all eight first-round passes landed and the lantern bough was re-laid to the reference. Frame 1 s vs ours: the bough now enters from the left edge as a ~0.4 m limb with pods near (0.08,0.55) and (0.18,0.48) instead of a beam across the top; stair treads are distinct chipped slabs with dark risers and a grass bank at tread height; flagstones are 474 Voronoi cells with mossy joints; houses have ridged bark, lit doorways and thatch domes with vines. Still different: Saria's house sits in the centre of frame A where the reference has a hedge and mist; far hills are untextured grey; the grade is cooler and flatter; canopy cards near the camera read as large flat leaves; shafts are softer than the reference's hard diagonal slabs.

takes.subject: fable-cursor log: tick 5 — take-0003, B camera, hedge request, round two
takes.note: Hourly take while round two is in flight (terrain lattice sampler, atmosphere GLSL and haze, trees canopy cards and far layers) and with the B camera moved closer to Saria's house. Frame 14 s vs ours: the house should now fill the right of frame with the door near (0.78,0.48) as in the reference instead of sitting small at centre-right; frame 1 s: the centre of A still shows the lit doorway where the reference has a dark hedge (hedge requested from codex); the far hills remain a flat grey band where the reference layers three silhouette planes into the haze; shaft slabs are still softer and the whole grade a notch cooler than the reference's golden light on olive greens.

takes.subject: Trees round two: near-eye laminae instead of canopy cards, boughs over Saria's roof, far depth bands, sun corridors for shafts
takes.note: Round two landed: the terrain sampler now equals the rendered mesh (query-order variance 0, stair/plaza probe mismatch 1e-6 m), atmosphere haze rebuilt on the measured reference (56 percent at 30 m, warm grey #6c6c65 to #91918b, luminous warm sky with no blue), GLSL smoothstep and fog-integral NaN fixed, near-eye giant foliage as small laminae instead of large cards, boughs arching over Saria's dome, two far tree bands north of the log for a third depth layer, sun corridors through the crowns for bolder shafts. Versus the reference: A's centre still shows the lit doorway behind an open terrace (hedge pending from codex), the canopy roof reads paler than the reference's dark crisp crowns because haze also thins the upward rays, and the log arch in D is still largely veiled by mist.

takes.subject: layout: re-lay the hero stairway and camera A to the reference's geometry
takes.note: Shot A re-laid to the reference geometry: the hero stairway now runs almost radially from a level camera A (base 13.7 m away at bearing 55 deg, 3.2 m wide) so it projects to (0.61-0.77, 0.66)->(0.70-0.82, 0.28) against the reference (0.62-0.80, 0.62)->(0.70-0.78, 0.27); a dark hedge on the bank hides Saria trunk and doorway from A while B keeps the door clear; the stair-foot boulder sits at the reference (0.9, 0.7); the lantern bough rides higher with long cords so the pods hang at the reference height; the upper house moved out of frame. Structures round three landed (7.5 cm vine leaves, mushroom-cap roof, carved sign). Remaining gaps: upper third darker than the reference haze, left bank brighter, log arch in D still veiled, canopy pale from F.

takes.subject: terrain/hardscape: warm stone albedo, flat slab tops, banks hug the re-laid stairway
takes.note: Hour 19: hardscape round three against the reference plaza (warm beige slabs R-B 49, dark soil joints, slabs sitting flat): path flattening noise cut 6 cm to 2.5 cm because the old undulation buried a quarter of every slab top under joint fill (the fat joints and soil blobs seen in every take so far), joints 2-5 cm, warm stone albedo (plaza R-B 34 to 43, stone/grass 1.05 to 1.28 vs reference 1.21), lighter warmer treads with dark risers, banks now hug the re-laid stairway and the 2.7 m cliff at Saria pad ring is gone. Composition: two pods at the reference (0.10,0.44)/(0.25,0.45), camera D past the bough tip so the house stair sits at the right edge like the reference, signpost at x 0.58 in B. Atmosphere grade pass (contrast, F canopy haze, far haze luminance) is in the working tree mid-flight; remaining gaps: sunlit pavement too bright in B, grass brighter than the reference in D, canopy pale from F.

takes.subject: agents: tick 10 log — take-0008, measured gaps, vegetation-tone notice to codex
takes.note: Hour 20: atmosphere round three measured against the reference with luminance percentiles: the tone curve and sun-to-shade ratio already matched the reference stone (lit 0.62-0.66, shaded 0.33-0.40), so the grade is now a chroma-preserving power curve with a slight black lift, haze is altitude-aware (uniform to 8 m, scale height 14 m, 75 percent cut on rays steeper than 20 deg) so the canopy from F reads as dark crowns against luminous gaps (F darkest quartile 0.41 to 0.30 vs reference 0.25), ground mist thinned so the log arch in D is a silhouette not grey mush. Remaining measured gaps being worked in the tree: the A plaza sits in the lantern tree crown shadow under the pinned sun where the reference plaza is dappled sunlit (trees pass: sun corridors, thinner low crown in A upper-left, bark #a8a89a to ~#6c604a), and vegetation albedo is too bright (lit grass 0.50 vs 0.34-0.37; palette/material pass).

takes.subject: ledger: take-0009 — A SSIM 0.189 (best), hue delta 0.02 deg in A; monitor 009b818; claims hour 20
takes.note: Hour 21: the A plaza was fully in the lantern tree crown shadow under the rubric-pinned sun while the reference plaza is dappled sunlit (p50 0.55, p90 0.66); two porous sun corridors through the crown now put leaf-dappled sun on the slabs (p90 0.62 to 0.77, pixels above 0.7 from 6 to 22 percent) and on the B path; the lantern bough lobes are thinned so A upper-left reads as boughs with haze between clusters (darkest quartile 0.28 to 0.34 vs reference 0.385); giant bark went from pale grey #cfc6b8 to the reference dark warm #9b7e62. Vegetation albedo measured 40 percent too bright (lit grass 0.50 vs 0.34-0.37): grass/moss/fern palette 0.6x at the same hue band, lit meadow now 0.374 vs reference 0.37. In flight: exposure rebalance because the sunlit slabs now read 0.1 too bright and the exposed sun halo lifts F.

takes.subject: atmosphere: exposure rebalance for the sunlit plaza; god rays no longer wash F
takes.note: Hour 22: exposure rebalanced for the now sunlit plaza. A rays-off decomposition showed the god rays alone lifted the F canopy mid band darkest quartile from 0.22 to 0.43 (reference 0.23): fully lit 50 m columns above the roof plus a 22 percent smear painting sky columns onto the near trunk; the ray march now follows the haze altitude profile and smear taps are weighted by marched-length difference, sky-column share halved. Sun 5.0 to 3.0, hemi 0.95 with khaki ground bounce, haze from 2.5 m. A plaza p10/p50/p90 0.42/0.54/0.77 to 0.37/0.48/0.68 vs reference 0.33/0.55/0.66; B path 0.635 to 0.488 vs 0.483; D arch 0.447 to 0.430 vs 0.427. Regressions from the corridor pass fixed: leaf count 195k to 209k, third bough pod restored out of frame, D purple bed 0.0024 to 0.0061. Remaining: D path in crown shadow (0.31 vs 0.46), no gap glare over the hollow in D, near lantern-tree cluster in A upper-left; trees pass and grass re-measure under the new key running.

takes.subject: ledger: take-0011 — exposure rebalance; monitor 6cc8279
takes.note: Hour 23: grass re-measured under the rebalanced key (sun 3.0): D lit meadow 0.351 and shaded p50 0.275 sit within 0.02 of the reference 0.34-0.37 / 0.24-0.28, vegetation-hue pixels (83,84,53) vs reference (84,84,46), so no albedo change; the compressed lit tail (p90 0.42 vs 0.49) is key/fill/haze, not albedo. Trees follow-up in the tree mid-flight against three measured D/A gaps: the D path foreground reads 0.31 vs the reference sunlit 0.46 because it lies in crown shadow (porous sun corridor over the spine), D shows no gap glare through the roof over the hollow where the reference top band is 0.54 vs our 0.49, and the near lantern-tree cluster keeps A upper-left darkest quartile at 0.33 vs 0.385. take-0011 was the best take in every view but F (A 0.198, B 0.187, D 0.242, E 0.205).

takes.subject: agents: tick 12 log — round four complete, best takes, remaining gaps
takes.note: Hour 0: trees round four against measured D/A gaps: the D path foreground lay in crown shadow (stone half p50 0.416 vs reference sunlit 0.493) so two porous sun corridors over the spine now put dappled sun on the slabs (0.469); D showed no gap glare through the roof over the hollow where the reference top band reads 0.54, so three view corridors from camera D open leaf-fringed gaps (0.496 to 0.509) and the far silhouette rows are capped to 23 m variants so their crowns fall inside the frame; the lantern limb lobes are confined to the middle of the bough so A upper-left darkest quartile is 0.378 vs the reference 0.385. Camera D moved onto the spine axis because our foreground was half grass verge where the reference is all flagstone (D SSIM 0.240 to 0.253). Remaining: B path over-lit under the rebalanced key (p50 0.64 vs 0.49), sharper texture statistics than the soft video frames, and 26 auto-passing items awaiting cross-review.

takes.subject: grade: saturation 1.03 -> 1.12, green desat 0.15 -> 0.08, exposure 0.94
takes.note: Hour 1: shot B path was over-lit under the rebalanced key (p50 0.63, p90 0.73 vs reference dappled shade 0.49 / 0.62) because the plaza sun corridor at (2.5,0,2) cast its lit disc north to z -1; moved 1.5 m south (p50 0.536, p90 0.679) with the A plaza unchanged. Every view read 0.03-0.06 less saturated and 0.01-0.09 brighter than the reference frames, so the grade now runs saturation 1.12 (was 1.03), green desaturation 0.08 (was 0.15) and exposure 0.94: saturation lands within 0.02 of the reference in A/B/D/E, luminance within 0.01-0.06 (C/F still bright), hue delta down in B/D/E, F similarity 0.155 to 0.173. Remaining: C look-back still 0.07 bright and under-saturated, F under-saturated, stone hue in E reads 44.7 vs 51.2 deg (too orange), and 26 auto-passing items await codex cross-review.

takes.subject: hardscape: stone hue on the reference's yellow-beige, short khaki joint sprouts
takes.note: Hour 2: colour statistics against the reference by luminance band. Our soil and joints were orange-brown (hue 34-37 deg) where the reference dark ground is olive (52-57): palette soil to 0x69613c / 0x423b26. The sunlit slabs read R/G 1.13 vs the reference 1.08 (hue 42 vs 47.6 in E): the hue was set by the hardscape GLSL desaturation/lift targets, not the base colour, so those moved to yellow-beige (simulated albedo R/G 1.166 to 1.083 at equal luminance); bright-band hue now E 45.5, A 47.9, B 46.9, D 49.1 vs reference 47.6 / 47.4 / 44.7 / 47.2; hue delta E 5.9 to about 2.2, D 3.3 to 1.7, B 1.6 to 0.2. Joint sprouts shortened to 6-9 cm khaki tufts from 11-17 cm lime blades (817, W21 holds). Remaining: C look-back 0.07 too bright and under-saturated because the airlight ignores view direction (atmosphere pass in the tree), D shade carries more blue than the reference warm shade (fill/IBL colour), 26 items await codex cross-review.

takes.subject: agents: tick 14 log — round five colour passes, remaining gaps
takes.note: Hour 3: the airlight ignored view direction, so the look-back shot C (camera facing away from the sun) read 0.419 vs the reference 0.353 and grey (saturation 0.117 vs 0.170) while the sunward views were within 0.03. Haze, god rays, sky dome and ground mist now share one Mie-like lobe around the sun: warm forward tint, back-scatter falling to 0.62x for haze and 0.45x for rays beyond 135 deg, extinction unchanged. A rays-off decomposition showed the ray in-scatter was the dominant grey wash in C because the old HG g of 0.15 is nearly flat behind the camera. C now 0.365 / 0.154 with SSIM 0.178 to 0.187; A/B/D/F means move under 0.005; sky gap glare #a39e8a matches the reference #aca896 chroma; F hue delta 1.6 to 0.2 deg. This take is the first clean-tree take with the stone hue and directional airlight together. Remaining: A/C shaded vegetation band 58 deg vs reference 51, D shaded slabs bluer than the reference warm shade (fill/IBL), codex cross-review pending.

takes.subject: agents: tick 15 log — fill/airlight tests, remaining gaps
takes.note: Hour 4: colour statistics against the reference by luminance band. A warm hemisphere fill (0xd0c6a6) was measured and reverted: it traded A/C hue for D/E hue and over-saturated E. The airlight was warmed instead (linear B/R 0.89 to 0.84) because the reference hazed regions read B/R 0.87 while our mid-distance band carried nine more blue: hue delta D 2.0 to 1.75 deg, E 2.5 to 2.35, saturation on the reference in A/C/D (0.161/0.171/0.158 vs 0.157/0.170/0.157). Side by side after all colour passes, A matches within sat 0.004 / lum 0.018 and D within sat 0.000 / lum 0.008. Remaining: A/C shaded vegetation band reads 57 vs the reference 51 deg (deep grass albedo hue, vegetation owner), W37 needs the characters and HUD of Phase 2/3 in frame, 26 auto-passing items await codex cross-review.
